properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for Enforcing Regular Security Awareness Training
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that regular Security Awareness & Training is conducted.Training should include training for users and administrators on social engineering tactics (phishing, vishing, pretexting) and reporting procedures.
